# Cardinal at Work

> Stanford's comprehensive HR and benefits portal providing employees and retirees with centralized access to health insurance, retirement planning, and life event management through the Sequoia system and My Benefits Portal.

Cardinal at Work serves as Stanford University's primary digital hub for human resources, benefits administration, and employee wellness. The platform integrates the Sequoia HRIS system with the Manager Toolkit and My Benefits Portal to help faculty, staff, and retirees manage their benefits, navigate life events, and access retirement planning resources.

## Key Topics

- My Benefits Portal
- Health Insurance
- Retirement Planning
- Benefits Enrollment
- Life Events
- Health Savings Account (HSA)
- Medicare
- Life Insurance
- Dependent Coverage
- Open Enrollment
- COBRA
- Retiree Benefits
- Sequoia
- Wellness Programs
- Benefits Changes

## Benefits Portal & Core Services

- [Cardinal at Work](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu): Stanford's HR portal featuring Sequoia system, Manager Toolkit, and employee benefits
- [My Benefits Portal](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal): Central portal for managing benefits, HSA, and open enrollment at Stanford
- [Benefits & Rewards](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards): Main benefits hub covering health insurance, wellness, retirement, and paid time off

## Life Events & Benefits Changes

- [Change Your Benefits](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits): Guide to updating benefits during life events, COBRA, and qualified changes
- [Marriage & Partnership](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/marriage-partnership): Instructions for updating benefits coverage after marriage or partnership
- [Birth, Adoption, or Foster of a Child](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/birth-adoption-or-foster-child): Guide for enrolling dependents and dependent benefits after birth or adoption
- [Death & Survivorship](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/death-survivorship): Information on benefits changes for surviving dependents and life insurance
- [Employment Changes](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/employment-changes): Guide for updating benefits with employment status or position changes
- [Dependent Eligibility Changes](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/dependent-eligibility-changes): Instructions for updating dependent coverage and eligibility verification

## Enrollment & Eligibility

- [Eligibility & Enrollment](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/eligibility-enrollment): Overview of employee eligibility requirements and benefits enrollment process
- [Certify Dependents for Benefits Coverage](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/eligibility-enrollment/certify-dependents-benefits-coverage): Instructions for dependent verification and certification documentation

## Faculty & Staff Benefits

- [Faculty & Staff Benefits Overview](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/faculty-staff-benefits-overview): Comprehensive overview of health, wellness, and retirement benefits for faculty
- [Offerings for Global Staff & Affiliates](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/faculty-staff-benefits-overview/offerings-global-staff-affiliates): Benefits offerings for international staff including Cigna Global and insurance

## Retirement & Age-Based Changes

- [Retiree Benefits Overview](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/retiree-benefits-overview): Overview of medical, dental, vision, and tuition benefits for Stanford retirees
- [Qualifications for Retirement](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/retiree-benefits-overview/qualifications-retirement): Retirement eligibility criteria including Rule of 55 and Rule of 75
- [Approaching Age 65](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/approaching-age-65): Medicare enrollment and retiree health care planning guidance for age 65
- [Becoming Medicare Eligible](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/becoming-medicare-eligible): Guide for Medicare-eligible retirees on enrollment and coverage changes
- [Enrolling in Retiree Health Care](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/enrolling-retiree-health-care): Step-by-step enrollment guide for Stanford retiree health care benefits

## Transitions & Special Circumstances

- [Leaving Stanford](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/my-benefits-portal/change-your-benefits/leaving-stanford): Guide to COBRA, retirement planning, and benefits continuation when leaving
- [Your Benefits on Leave](https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards/time-leaves/leaves-absence/your-benefits-leave): Explanation of health, life, and FSA benefits during paid and unpaid leave
